states.description: The Land of High Passes with stunning high-altitude lakes, Tibetan Buddhist gompas, rugged moonscapes, and rich Silk Route traditions.
states.heritage_overview: Famous for cliffside Buddhist monasteries, ancient mud-brick royal palaces, Mani walls, and Chortens.
active_stories: The shifting turquoise and azure colors of Pangong Tso Lake at 4,225m.
Royal Tibetan architecture at Leh Palace towering over the Indus Valley.
The 106-foot Maitreya Buddha and Bactrian camel safaris in Nubra Valley.

cities.name: Leh
cities.tagline: Capital of the High Himalayas
cities.description: Ancient Himalayan crossroads town featuring 17th-century royal palaces, white-domed peace stupas, and bustling bazaars.

monuments.name: Leh Palace & Tsemo Fort
monuments.summary: 17th-century nine-storey royal cliffside palace modeled on the Potala Palace of Lhasa.
monuments.historical_significance: Built by King Sengge Namgyal around 1600 CE as the seat of the Namgyal dynasty.
monuments.attribution: ASI Leh Circle

monuments.name: Shanti Stupa
monuments.summary: White-domed Buddhist Chorten perched atop Changspa hill inaugurated by the 14th Dalai Lama.
monuments.historical_significance: Inaugurated in 1991 to promote world peace and commemorate 2,500 years of Buddhism.
monuments.attribution: Ladakh Tourism

tourist_places.name: Pangong Tso Lake
tourist_places.summary: World highest endorheic saltwater lake at 4,225m altitude, famed for shifting colors from turquoise to deep azure.
tourist_places.historical_significance: Ancient natural wonder spanning 134 km across Ladakh and Tibet.
tourist_places.attribution: Ladakh Tourism Department

tourist_places.name: Magnetic Hill
tourist_places.summary: Gravity-defying optical illusion hill on the Leh-Kargil National Highway where vehicles appear to roll uphill.
tourist_places.historical_significance: Legendary optical illusion milestone marked by Border Roads Organisation.
tourist_places.attribution: Ladakh Tourism

local_transit.tips: Regulated fixed rates by All Ladakh Tour Operator Association.

live_travel_info.best_season: May to September
live_travel_info.weather_summary: Intense high-altitude sunshine by day; cool to sub-zero nights.
live_travel_info.advisory: Mandatory 48-hour acclimatization in Leh before high passes.

active_stories: Sunset prayer bells at Shanti Stupa with panoramic views over the snow-capped Zanskar range.

cities.name: Nubra Valley
cities.tagline: Valley of Flowers & High-Altitude Sand Dunes
cities.description: Dramatic desert valley crossed by Shyok River, home to white dunes, Bactrian camels, and Diskit Gompa.

monuments.name: Diskit Monastery & 106ft Maitreya Buddha
monuments.summary: Oldest and largest Buddhist monastery in Nubra crowned by a monumental 32-meter Maitreya Buddha statue.
monuments.historical_significance: Founded in the 14th century by Changzem Tserab Zangpo of the Gelugpa (Yellow Hat) school.
monuments.attribution: Ladakh Tourism

tourist_places.name: Hunder Sand Dunes & Bactrian Camels
tourist_places.summary: White high-altitude sand dunes flanked by snow peaks where double-humped Silk Route Bactrian camels roam.
tourist_places.historical_significance: Living heritage of the ancient Silk Route across Khardung La.
tourist_places.attribution: Ladakh Tourism

live_travel_info.best_season: May to September
live_travel_info.weather_summary: Crisp desert mountain days; clear star-filled skies at night.

active_stories: Ride double-humped camels through the white dunes of Hunder as twilight paints the Himalayas gold.
